accepted_theorem: For every prime q>=11 and every integer q<d<2q, no binary 5q-by-5q original fixed-phase Fourier equality mask exists.
model: D[r,c]=R[r,c]*zeta_(5q)^(r*c); either square Gram identity dI implies both; row and column regularity retained.
q7_control: Exact 7-by-35 row block with Gram 11 I_7; not a square equality mask and no conclusion at (35,11).
independent_controls: CHECK_RESULTS.json; candidate programs not imported or executed; exact integer cyclotomic arithmetic.
